faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Seedream V4.5 Text to Image

q1.question: What is Seedream V4.5 Text to Image?
q1.answer: Seedream V4.5 is an AI model that generates images from text descriptions.

q2.question: How long does it take to generate an image?
q2.answer: Generation time varies, but typically takes a few seconds to a minute.

q3.question: What formats are supported?
q3.answer: We support PNG, JPEG, and WEBP formats.

q4.question: 它支援中文提示詞嗎？
q4.answer: 是的，Seedream 4.5 對英文和中文的理解同樣出色。您可以使用任一語言編寫提示詞，或混合使用兩種語言。

q5.question: 與 GPT-Image-1 有什麼區別？
q5.answer: Seedream 4.5 在雙語提示詞和多圖片混合（在圖片轉圖片模式下）方面表現出色。GPT-Image-1 在圖片內文字渲染方面更好。根據您的主要需求選擇。
